title: Oracle Enterprise Contracts - Manager
description:
**About The Role**
As a Manager in our Oracle Applications practice, you will lead client engagements to implement and optimize Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Contracts. You will act as a trusted advisor to client legal, procurement, finance, and sales leaders, shaping their contract management strategy and delivering the solutions that bring it to life. The role blends solution leadership, engagement management, people leadership, and business development.

Client advisory
  
  

* Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts
* CLM
* Sell Contracts
* Procurement Contracts
* Fit-gap analysis
* Solution architecture
* Data migration (FBDI)
* Cross Module integration
* Engagement and financial management
* Team leadership
* Business development

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* 10+ years of Oracle ERP experience, including 3+ years in Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts.

* Oracle Cloud certifications (Procurement, Contracts, or Cloud Implementation Professional).

Industry experience in sectors such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or technology.

title: Technical Sales - Dyes
description:

description:
**Job Title:** **Project Executive – Planning / Cost Control**

**Department:** Projects / Project Management

**Location:** Kolkata Head Office and project sites, as required

**Experience:** Indicatively 5–8 years in planning and project controls for building construction / real estate projects; final experience range to be confirmed.

**Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering. A qualification in Construction / Project Management will be an added advantage.

**Salary:** Upto 60K CTC Monthly

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Executive – Planning to support project planning, scheduling, progress monitoring and coordination across construction projects. The role will involve preparing and updating project schedules, tracking actual progress against planned milestones, identifying delays and supporting project teams in taking timely corrective action.

**Required Skills:**

· Strong understanding of construction sequencing, project scheduling and building construction activities.

· Working knowledge of Primavera P6 and / or MS Project; proficiency in MS Excel and preparation of MIS reports.

· Ability to prepare baseline programmes, look-ahead schedules, progress curves and milestone trackers.

· Understanding of critical path, resource planning, productivity monitoring and delay analysis.

· Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural and MEP drawings and project specifications.

· Strong analytical, coordination, communication and documentation skills.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

· Prepare, maintain and periodically update the overall project master schedule in consultation with the Project Head and site teams.

· Break down project scope into activities, define activity sequences, durations, dependencies and key milestones.

· Prepare baseline programmes, monthly plans, weekly look-ahead schedules and activity-wise execution targets.

· Collect and validate physical progress data from project sites and update planned-versus-actual progress reports.

· Monitor critical path activities, identify slippages and highlight potential delays, bottlenecks and interface issues.

· Coordinate with civil, structural, MEP, procurement, contracts and consultant teams to align work programmes and dependencies.

· Analyse reasons for delays and support preparation of recovery plans, mitigation measures and revised schedules.

· Monitor manpower, materials, equipment and contractor deployment against the approved programme.

· Prepare progress dashboards, S-curves, milestone reports and periodic MIS for management review.

· Follow up with responsible stakeholders on pending drawings, approvals, material decisions and other schedule-critical inputs.

· Participate in project review meetings, record MOM and track closure of planning-related action points.

· Maintain proper records of approved schedules, revisions, progress data and supporting documentation.

**🤝**
Client: Leading AI-Powered Voice Automation Platform

As part of our Customer Success team, you’ll sit at the intersection of AI, product, and real customer impact. * Build and manage strong relationships with enterprise clients, ensuring long-term value and engagement.
* Monitor agent performance, conduct audits, and continuously improve workflows using data and insights.
